title: Mixing: Check My Machine, Waterfalls, Nobody Knows, Coming Up by Paul McCartney | 1979
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eddie Klein

The fourth mixing session for Paul McCartney’s McCartney II album took place on 11 October 1979.

McCartney oversaw stereo mixes of ‘Check My Machine’, ‘Waterfalls’, ‘Nobody Knows’, and ‘Coming Up’. Of those, ‘Waterfalls’ and ‘Nobody Knows’ were used on the album.
